reason: Pure-Python library whose README Usage examples (signed-data verification, promotional offer signatures) run offline on CPU using bundled test keys/certs with no Apple account needed.
demo: README Usage: 'Verification Usage' (SignedDataVerifier) and 'Promotional Offer Signature Creation'
goal: Install the library from the repo (pip install of the clone, Python 3.8+) so that `appstoreserverlibrary` imports. Then, using the bundled test files tests/resources/certs/testCA.der, tests/resources/certs/testSigningKey.p8 and tests/resources/mock_signed_data/testNotification, make SignedDataVerifier (online checks disabled, SANDBOX, bundle id com.example, app id 1234) decode the notification via verify_and_decode_notification, and make PromotionalOfferSignatureCreator produce a signature. No Apple credentials or network API calls are needed.
check: A Python script imports the library, creates a promotional offer signature that verifies against the test key, and decodes the bundled test notification as type TEST.
